TSB Revision
ENGINE AND EMISSION CONTROL

DTC15 : Auto-cruise Control Switch System
CIRCUIT OPERATION
This circuit judges the signals of each switch ("OFF," 
"SET," "RESUME," "CANCEL" and "MAIN") of the 
auto-cruise control switch. 
The auto-cruise control-ECU detects the state of the 
auto-cruise control switch by sensing the voltages 
shown below.
